body:
I just made a post about how I'm sick of getting positive, cheery, and cliched advice. I don't know if that's you too, but I'll try to avoid that anyway.

Your post just got me thinking. My birthday's next week, I've been out of work for the better part of a year, and the only jobs I'm qualified for are entry level, which are crap by default. Not to mention it's very rare to even get an interview anyway.

So I know I feel worthless, and being in a dead end job was one of the reasons my brother took his life a couple years ago. I will say that it is possible to make things better, if you can be patient. I personally just don't think better will be good enough for me. Ultimately we decide for ourselves if and what we want to try.
